text:
My son had orthodontic treatment at this clinic by a male doctor (a bit overweight). His treatment finished in July of last year, and he wears his retainer regularly as recommended. Currently, his front teeth protrude, a problem that has persisted since the treatment ended last year. Initially, not many people noticed, but now that several have, it's affecting his self-confidence. So, I took him to consult the same doctor. His response was that we would have to pay for a new set of braces, showing no empathy whatsoever. He blamed the child, who was under 15 at the time. The doctor was only concerned with the cost and disregarded medical ethics and the emotional distress of his young patient. I urge the management to address and improve this doctor's attitude to protect the clinic's reputation and the image of other doctors. P.S. This clinic also has many other good doctors.

**Additional Information:** After the clinic management called (I requested that this doctor's name be removed from this review), the same doctor claimed to the management that my son didn't want any tooth extraction, which caused the protruding teeth!?!?!?!? (My son was 13-14 years old at the time). However, my son told me the doctor said extraction wasn't necessary and that braces could be used directly. That day, I took my child to the dentist myself. I waited outside and wasn't called into the treatment room. I was confused because, based on my previous experience taking my daughter for orthodontic treatment elsewhere, the doctor would always call her in for a consultation to clean her mouth and plan the treatment. But that day, my daughter came out with braces already put on. My family was also surprised, but we thought it might be a modern orthodontic treatment because the doctor was relatively young.

The doctor's explanation sounded contradictory and illogical. My daughter wanted braces because her upper teeth protruded and she wanted them to be straighter, but the doctor claimed to the management that my daughter's teeth protruded because she refused to have any extractions!?!?!?!?! Did the doctor explain to my daughter or her guardian that her teeth would protrude if they weren't extracted? I was completely confused. My daughter knew she needed to have her mouth cleaned first (fillings, extractions, like her older sister had done). And as far as I know, if a child is underage, the doctor must consult with their guardian first. I wasn't called into the treatment room that day (I didn't go in with my daughter initially because I remember being on the phone).

text:
I went for a dental check-up in mid-October 2025. I informed them that I had severe tooth pain and suspected I would need root canal treatment. On the day of the appointment, the dentist took an x-ray and informed me that the painful tooth needed root canal treatment from another dentist. (Why didn't they schedule an appointment with a root canal specialist from the start? I'm very confused. It wasted my time and the cost of a new appointment.) That dentist found other cavities that weren't painful and filled those instead. After more than two months, the filling came out while I was drinking water. Luckily, I didn't swallow it. In my entire life, I've never encountered a dentist who could have a filling come out in less than three months. When I reported it to the clinic, they ignored me and showed no responsibility. I'm very disappointed.
Furthermore, at my next appointment with the root canal specialist, they took another x-ray. The dentist still couldn't do it, saying that the painful tooth was too deeply decayed for root canal treatment. They said I would need gum surgery, bone grafting at the hospital, or extraction with an implant, etc. So I wasted money on the check-up and x-rays that day without receiving any treatment.
Finally, I decided to get checked at Ramathibodi Hospital. The dentist was able to perform the root canal treatment on the same day as the appointment without needing to cut the gums or drill bone beforehand.
In summary, it was a clinic that was unprepared and lacked the ability to provide the treatment I needed, resulting in a waste of my money. I will not use their services again. The money I paid was for a bad experience in my life. Thank you.
